rubrics.justification: Describes ICM and TE plausibly and notes limits of a single still image, but it hedges against the provided 4AA hatching designation and may undercall expansion/hatching stage.
Integrates age, BMI, endometrium, ovarian response, sperm parameters, smoking, and prior cycle history well, though it overemphasizes questioning the DOR label despite the case diagnosis.

Overall logic is structured and mostly consistent, but there are mild contradictions such as calling the embryo possibly better than average AA while also questioning whether it is truly hatching, and the DOR discussion is somewhat inconsistent with the supplied labs.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading concepts, single embryo transfer principles, smoking cessation advice, and cautious discussion of PGT-A; minor deviations include speculative comments about overdiagnosis of DOR and some nonessential add-on suggestions.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, monitoring, and future-cycle considerations, though some recommendations remain somewhat generic rather than tightly case-specific.
